neighbours.label: Sentence-ending punctuation after a factual completed event in conversational narrative.
fire: After weeks of waiting, Anna did find a room. Her brother was relieved.
Well, I made an agreement with Daniel. That explains the change.
Despite all the trouble, we actually reached the cabin. Everyone was exhausted.
You know, Sam finally got the tickets. We were delighted.
After a long conversation, I told Maria about the letter. She looked surprised.
To my amazement, the mechanic did repair the engine. We drove home.
Believe it or not, the neighbors moved out yesterday. The house was quiet.
In the end, Peter signed the agreement. We all relaxed.

notes: Random 16-pole sweep. Labels derived from both-pole cards and top-32 peak-token counts. No band archive covers this neuron. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory probes, when declared, used different sentences from this pre-registration. Mixed card peaks, mostly punctuation.
